key_findings: BIP and IRE-1α are neuronal in the ACC and upregulated (with pIRE-1α) after CCI; inhibiting them relieves hyperalgesia.
Electroacupuncture reduces CCI-induced BIP and pIRE-1α in the ACC and attenuates neuropathic pain.
